title: SparkPack: First‑use efficiency cards and compact screenshot set for Optimize toolkit
creator: Maya Rivera
description: Create a concise set of onboarding assets (called SparkPack) for first‑time users of the Optimize toolkit. Deliver a small library of compact cards, microcopy, and annotated screenshots that introduce batching, prefix/KV caching suggestions, and the quantization toggle UX. Assets will be used in the Console first‑run flow, docs quickstarts, and the product tour.
design_goals: Explain batching and caching tradeoffs in one or two sentences per card
Surface quantization options in-context with clear default recommendations
Keep visuals compact to fit a single console modal on mobile and narrow desktop panes
Provide screenshot variants with and without SDK code snippets
Make metrics-first cards (latency/cost delta) for engineers and PMs
proposed_screens: SparkCard: throughput vs latency microcard (icon, 2 lines, delta metrics)
CacheTip: prefix/KV cache status pill + toggle + example suggestion
QuantSwitch: quantization slider with recommended profile cards (fast/cheap/accurate)
SummaryStrip: three‑panel compact summary used at end of quickstart modal
ScreenshotSet: Console modal w/ highlighted elements + mobile crop
assets_needed: 1 set of annotated console screenshots (desktop + mobile) from QA environment
SVG icons for latency, tokens, and accuracy
acceptance_criteria: Five compact assets exported (SVG/PNG) and uploaded to Drive
One annotated screenshot set (desktop + mobile) showing batching/kvcache/quant UX
Microcopy approved by PM and Eng (link to approval in comments)
Figma file link with dev handoff notes and specs (spacing, type, color tokens)
Console engineering signoff on pixel placement for modal variant
